title: Governed Migration 1052 tenant platform plugin readiness

phases.objective: Provide one exact-token, Production-bound, checksum-bound readiness bridge for Migration 1052 that records durable governed authorization and performs dry-run only after source and runtime parity, while keeping Migration Apply, Runtime Dispatch Certification, Managed Execution, provider calls, credential payload access, protected-ref mutation, and external writes outside this PR.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Issue 4451 exact authorization comment on the trusted default-branch workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The trusted workflow proves exact Migration 1052 source identity and Production/runtime parity, creates a short-lived governed capability envelope, records and durably reads back the checksum-bound migration authorization, and completes governed_migration_execute in dry_run mode with applies_sql=false and zero preflight risks, without any Apply or managed repair execution path.
steps: Require issue 4451, the exact Migration 1052 authorization token, and OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR author association before the readiness job can start.
Require source PR 6763 merge identity, exact Migration 1052 Git blob SHA, raw-byte SHA-256 checksum, and executable statement count to remain pinned.
Require protected Production and public runtime readbacks to equal the promoted Production SHA before creating migration authorization.
Create or approve a short-lived capability resolution envelope scoped to governed_migration_authorization_bootstrap and the exact Migration 1052 resource binding.
Record checksum/source-bound governed migration authorization and verify exactly one durable registry row with matching checksum, statement count, source PR, and source merge SHA.
Invoke governed_migration_execute only with mode dry_run and require applies_sql=false, the exact checksum and statement count, and zero preflight risks.

Upload sanitized readiness evidence that explicitly records Migration Apply, Runtime Dispatch Certification, Managed Execution, provider calls, credential payload access, protected-ref mutation, force push, and external writes as false.
assertions: The workflow has no Migration 1052 Apply trigger, Apply phase, or Apply job.
The executor contains no governed_migration_execute call with mode apply.
The bridge never invokes tenantPlatformPluginManagedRepairExecutor or creates a Managed Execution run.
Runtime Dispatch Certification issuance remains absent and separately governed.
Production mismatch, runtime mismatch, source identity drift, migration checksum drift, statement-count drift, authorization mismatch, or dry-run preflight risk fails closed.
No provider mutation, credential payload publication, protected-ref mutation, force push, or external business write is introduced.
